firstPlayerRule: The Sheriff takes all five dice and starts the game. With three players, the Deputy starts instead.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise. Roles are dealt randomly; the three-player game uses Deputy, Outlaw and Renegade, with no Sheriff.
